questions.text:
Answer ONE question from ONE area of study. Answer BOTH parts of your chosen question, with reference to TWO art works and TWO formal elements chosen from: form, colour, light, composition, media/materials, line, scale, space, technique, tone, decorative features.

TOWARDS MODERNISM (c.1780-1900)
Question 1: Select TWO art works that feature contrasting approaches. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in producing contrasting approaches in this period.

Question 2: Select TWO art works that depict interior and/or exterior settings. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in representing interior and/or exterior settings in this period.

ART IN AOTEAROA (c.1800-1980)
Question 3: Select TWO art works that feature contrasting approaches. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in producing contrasting approaches in this period.

Question 4: Select TWO art works that represent contrasting places. (a) Describe the formal elements and the effects they create. (b) Explain the importance of these effects in representing contrasting places in this period.
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (3-4 marks): Examine the effects of formal elements of art works. Demonstrate through the description of the formal elements of art works, and description of the effects created by these, using evidence from the art works. The candidate describes formal elements in two art works and describes some effects, using some evidence from the art works. Some understanding is evident. Merit (5-6 marks): Examine in depth the effects of formal elements. Demonstrate through the detailed description of formal elements, and explanation of the effects created by these, using evidence from the art works. The candidate describes in some detail and begins to explain the effects, using pertinent evidence. In-depth understanding is consistently evident. Excellence (7-8 marks): Examine perceptively the effects of formal elements. Demonstrate through the detailed description of formal elements, and explanation of the importance of specific effects created in art works. The candidate convincingly or perceptively explains the importance of specific effects of the formal elements, using evidence from the art works. May make effective use of context to support explanations. Perceptive understanding is consistently evident.
